notes:
Verified by curling raw HTML (HTTP 200, Chrome UA) from three live Squarespace 7.1 sites: nerine-floral.squarespace.com (default subdomain), samfresquez.com and notcrispyenough.com (both on CUSTOM domains). All primary signatures reproduced on all three, proving they survive custom-domain hosting.

DETECTION (most reliable first):
1. `<!-- This is Squarespace. -->` is emitted inside <head> as effectively the first Squarespace-injected bytes, immediately followed by `<!-- <site-slug> -->` (e.g. `<!-- nerine-floral -->`, `<!-- coral-tunny-jcnj -->`). Closed by `<!-- End of Squarespace Headers -->`. This is the single most robust signal and works on custom domains, so match it in the raw HTML rather than trusting the URL. CONFIRMED on all 3 sites.
2. Inline JS global `Static.SQUARESPACE_CONTEXT = { ... }` (window.Static.SQUARESPACE_CONTEXT). JSON carries `templateId` (24-hex, e.g. 5c5a519771c10ba3470d8101), `templateVersion` ("7.1" observed on all inspected), `website`, `collection`, `pageType`, etc. CONFIRMED on all 3.
3. `<body id="collection-<24hex>">` plus many `tweak-*` classes and `sqs-*` classes (sqs-block, sqs-block-content, sqs-seven-one). `squarespace-announcement-bar` element also present. CONFIRMED on all 3.

META GENERATOR: NOT present on any inspected 7.1 site (grep for meta[name=generator] returned nothing). metaGenerator correctly left empty. Do NOT rely on a "Squarespace" generator meta tag.

CDN / ASSET HOSTING (only domains actually observed are listed): images.squarespace-cdn.com (uploaded images; resizable via ?format=, request ?format=original for full-res), static1.squarespace.com (versioned-site-css / custom-css / static asset paths), assets.squarespace.com (shared framework CSS/JS bundles under /universal/...), definitions.sqspcdn.com (config/definition JSON), file.squarespace-cdn.com (file downloads, seen on notcrispyenough.com). Numbered static hosts static1..staticN are interchangeable edges but only static1 was observed.

RENDER: Content fully server-rendered in raw HTML (190KB-2.1MB responses with og tags, body copy, image markup), then JS-enhanced. Treat as ssr-static; no headless render needed for basic mirroring, though blog/gallery templates lazy-load images so a scroll pass helps.

ANTI-BOT: none. Plain HTTP 200 with standard browser UA on all 3, no Cloudflare/captcha challenge. Squarespace fronts with its own CDN.

BADGE: No persistent "Made with Squarespace" badge in DOM of paid/template sites (grep found none). badgePresent=false.

ANALYTICS: First-party analytics only; no default third-party GA/GTM domain injected unless owner adds one.

detectUrlRegex `\.squarespace\.com` matches only the default subdomain; the majority of real sites use custom domains, so ALWAYS pair URL detection with the raw-HTML `<!-- This is Squarespace. -->` + SQUARESPACE_CONTEXT check for coverage.
